evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:26-26
anchor_quotes: the chanting and drumming is getting much louder
grabbed by the tendrils and absorbed into the wall
all except spots along the wall where there are glyphs

beats.title: Captain Idris and His Remaining Soldiers
beats.summary: At a tunnel split with an old grate, the party finds Captain Idris of the Guard and his surviving soldiers; his men are too terrified to continue, leaving only Idris and his mage Zora to help.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:28-28
anchor_quotes: a grizzled Captain of the Guard, Captain Idris
all his remaining men are too terrified to continue
Only Captain Idris and his mage, Zora, will continue on and help

beats.title: Bonogo Raids the Storage Room
beats.summary: Bonogo picks the lock on the other path's door, finds a storage room with crates and a chest buried in tendrils, is grappled when he grabs the chest, and escapes by vanishing with his new item.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:30-30
anchor_quotes: a storage room with various crates and a chest half buried in tendrils
he uses his new item and vanishes from the creature’s grasp

beats.title: Chest Opened: Scrolls, Old Letter, Dark Cloak
beats.summary: Karsemine cuts a tendril while Caelynn casts frost to slow the spread; Baergrom uses the crowbar to pry open the unyielding chest, revealing scrolls and a sealed letter, and Ephanna's Eldritch Blast uncovers a dark cloak.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:32-32
anchor_quotes: Baergrom borrows the crowbar from Bonogo and pries open the chest
rolled up scrolls and a very old sealed letter
rewarded with a mysteriously dark cloak

beats.title: Scrolls and a Letter from Mirathorn's Founding
beats.summary: The party reviews their loot, finding a fireball scroll and counterspell scroll, while Stafl reads the old letter's flowing script from the founding of Mirathorn describing a temple's construction; they continue to a large room.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:34-34
anchor_quotes: another fireball scroll as well as a counter spell scroll
the time of the founding of Mirathorn describing the construction of the temple in this area

beats.title: The Vast Chamber of Meat and Sacrifice
beats.summary: The party sees a 100-foot room with a central platform, walkways, churning blue-lit water below, meat-covered walls, giant tendrils feeding a central meat mound, and cultists throwing themselves in to be absorbed.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:36-36
anchor_quotes: the room is very large, about 100 feet across
throw themselves on it, being absorbed

beats.title: Enemy Forces Revealed and the Tunnel Attacks
beats.summary: From the tunnel the group assesses 3 Cultist Leaders, 4 Elite Guards, 4 regular guards, 4 meat monsters, and 3 tendrils; as they prepare spells and oils, the tunnel contracts and throws them prone onto a metal grid walkway.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:38-38
anchor_quotes: 3 Cultist Leaders positioned on the outside walkways, 4 Elite Guards stationed around the center
throwing them prone on a metal grid walkway

beats.title: Fireball and Leap Open the Biggest Fight
beats.summary: Caelynn casts the fireball scroll at the center platform, incinerating two Elite Guards, while Bonogo leaps to an Elite Guard by the tunnel, stabs him, and throws him off the walkway.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:40-40
anchor_quotes: Caelynn immediately seizes the opportunity to cast the Fireball scroll on the center platform
two of the Elite Guards are instantly incinerated
throwing him off the walkway to the depths below

beats.title: Caelynn's Featherfall Escape and Karsemine's Kills
beats.summary: A guard grapples Caelynn and they fall over the side, but she uses Featherfall and Tempestuous Magic to float back up while the guard plummets; Karsemine kills a guard with a scimitar slash and bonus-action strike, then attacks a meatling.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:42-42
anchor_quotes: She immediately cast Featherfall which then let her cast Tempestuous Magic and float back up
leaving the guard to plummet to his doom
kills the guard with a second slash of her scimitars

beats.title: Uncertain Finale of the Battle
beats.summary: The recap closes on a cliffhanger, questioning which way the battle will turn, whether a character may die, or if the group will end the corruption.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-15:24fa6f72ecfe:span:24fa6f72ecfe:44-44
anchor_quotes: Which way will the flow of the battle go?
Could this be the finale for one of the characters?
